title: Samarmad PCHE — pre-reveal prediction record

source.citation: Samarmad and Jaffal (2023), Results in Engineering 19, 101303
source.public_artifact_policy: No article PDF, source text, figure, table, or digitized experimental point values are redistributed. Commercial reuse is not cleared.

pre_reveal_prediction.geometry: Independent reconstruction of one periodic Model 6 corrugated channel cell; not author CAD

first_principles_straight_channel_screen.scope: Straight fully-developed semicircle screening only; not a corrugated Model 6 prediction.

openfoam_v10_at_250_s.mass_balance: PASS on all three grids; maximum imbalance 0.0896% against 0.5%
openfoam_v10_at_250_s.hot_cold_energy_balance: PASS on all three grids; maximum imbalance 3.6715% against 5%

calculix.interpretation: A prior single assumption-only pipeline shakedown is retained locally; it is not a Samarmad structural prediction or validation.

freeze.open_timestamps: Submitted to four remote calendars; blockchain confirmation pending

blinding_limit: The solver received no publication measurement values or result plots, but the human/orchestrator had prior abstract-level and Section 4.1-summary exposure; this is not a fully blind benchmark.

measurement_comparison.scoring_rule: After reveal, compare only a matching frozen experimental condition and measurement definition; otherwise label UNSCORED. No tuning of v1 after reveal.
